title: This page could not open in this browser
body: Something this browser saved earlier got in the way. We tried once to clear it by itself.
freshNote: Clears only this site's saved data in this browser (nothing else in your browser). You sign in again after it.
pageBody: If a page of this site will not open in this browser, or goes blank, press the button. Only this site's saved data in this browser is cleared: your other sites, passwords and tabs stay as they are.
failed: Could not clear it. Please try again.
